screen_gate: Proceed to a replacement selector only if ideal floor removes at least10% of complete head+consumer time on both patterns, above twice each absolute control drift. This conservative complete-operation gate follows the existing head screens; it is not a model TPS threshold or a strict mathematical upper bound.
qualification: Identical all-score/input/weight digests and placement plus CPU refs before timing; actual winner/tie fallback not yet implemented.
gate_provenance: The numeric10% comparison was recorded after timing began. It is a reference to existing S04/S05 component screens, NOT a preregistered gate for this new screen. Treat results descriptively; do not claim a predeclared failed performance gate.
